I've fetched the latest refs. Re-check pull request #1 for new commits or changes since your last review of it. Apply the same review standard, from the angle of attack your system instructions set out, and only from that angle, and only post findings you haven't already raised on this PR. Be sure you're looking at the most recent commit on its branch. Two constraints on the GitHub CLI here, because the token is deliberately privilege-minimized: always pass an explicit --json field list to `gh pr view` (a bare `gh pr view` also fetches statusCheckRollup, which this token cannot be granted permission for, so it fails outright), and do not use `gh pr checks` at all -- it needs that same permission and cannot work. CI status is therefore unavailable to you: review the code on its own merits, and never wait on or refer to check results.
